title: Kausalya's grief
introduction: Rama approaches his mother Kausalya to inform her of the calamity. Kausalya on hearing the news, faints. On recovering, she laments in the most grevious tones to Rama.
closing: || इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे विंशः सर्गः ||
Thus completes the twentieth canto of Ayodhya Kanda in srimad Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिंस्तु पुरुष्व्याघ्रे निष्क्रामति कृताञ्जलौ |
आर्तशच्दो महान् जज्ञे स्त्रीणाम न्तःपुरे तदा
verses.iast:
tasmiṃstu puruśhvyāghre niśhkrāmati kṛtāJṇjalau |
ārtaśacdo mahān jajJṇe strīṇāma ntaḥpure tadā
verses.translation: While Rama, the best of men was leaving, after offering salutation to his father, women in the palace were weaping loudly.

glosses.meaning: Then
that Rama
the best of men
While leaving
after offering salutation
among women
in the palace
there was
great aartashsbdaH = cry of pain.

verses.devanagari:
क्ऱ्^त्येष्वचोदितः पित्रा सर्वस्यान्तः पुरस्य च |
गतिर्यः शरणम् चासीत् स रोओमोऽद्य प्रवत्स्यति
verses.iast:
kR^tyeśhvacoditaḥ pitrā sarvasyāntaḥ purasya ca |
gatiryaḥ śaraṇam cāsīt sa roomo'dya pravatsyati
verses.translation: Which Rama, without being told by his father, used to do necessary activities and protect the entire palace, is about to go to exile now".

glosses.meaning: which Rama
without being prompted
by father kR^ityeshhu = in actions
became
the recourse
and protector
to entire
palace
such Rama
is going to exile
now.

verses.devanagari:
कौसल्यायाम् यथा युक्तो जनन्याम् वर्तते सदा |
तथैव वर्ततेऽस्मासु जन्मप्रभृति राघवः
verses.iast:
kausalyāyām yathā yukto jananyām vartate sadā |
tathaiva vartate'smāsu janmaprabhṛti rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "Rama, since he was born, was showing the same attention to us, as he was showing to his mother Kausalya."

glosses.meaning: Rama
since he was born
was behaving
in the same way
towards us
as how
attentive
always
towards Kausalya
who was the mother.

verses.devanagari:
न क्रुध्यत्यभिशस्तोऽपि क्रोधनीयानि वर्जयन् |
कृद्धान् प्रसादयन् सर्वान् स इतोऽद्य प्रवत्स्यति
verses.iast:
na krudhyatyabhiśasto'pi krodhanīyāni varjayan |
kṛddhān prasādayan sarvān sa ito'dya pravatsyati
verses.translation: "He used to avoid actions which created anger and soothed all those who were angry. Rama was not furious with those who abused him. Such Rama is going today to exile."

glosses.meaning: actions which created anger
soothed
all
who were angry
was not furious
even if abused
Such Rama Pravatsyati = is going to exile
to day
from here.

verses.devanagari:
अभुद्धिर्बत नो राजा जीवलोकम् चरत्ययम् |
यो गतिम् सर्वभूतानाम् परित्यजति राघवम्
verses.iast:
abhuddhirbata no rājā jīvalokam caratyayam |
yo gatim sarvabhūtānām parityajati rāghavam
verses.translation: "Our stupid king by abandoning Rama who was helpful to all beings , is offending all the beings."

glosses.meaning: Which Dasaratha parityajati = by abonding raaghavam = Rama gatim = who was helpful sarvabhuutaanaam = to all beings ayam = this naH rajahaa = our king abuddhiH = who is stupid
is offending jiivalokam = all beings."

verses.devanagari:
इति सर्वा महिष्यस्ता विवत्सा इव धेनवः |
पतिमाचुक्रुशुश्चैव सस्वरम् चापि चुक्रुशुः
verses.iast:
iti sarvā mahiśhyastā vivatsā iva dhenavaḥ |
patimācukruśuścaiva sasvaram cāpi cukruśuḥ
verses.translation: Thus, all the king consorts while weaping loudly, as cows which lost their Calves, abused their husband .

glosses.meaning: Thus sarvaaH = all taaH = those mahishhaH = king's consorts chukrushuHcha api = were weaping sasvaram = with sound
who lost their calves aachukrushushcha eva = also abused patim = husband.

verses.devanagari:
स हि चान्तः पुरे घोरमार्तशब्धम् महीपतिः |
पुत्रशोकाभिसन्तप्तः श्रुत्वा व्यालीयतासने
verses.iast:
sa hi cāntaḥ pure ghoramārtaśabdham mahīpatiḥ |
putraśokābhisantaptaḥ śrutvā vyālīyatāsane
verses.translation: After hearing the terrific distressful crying sounds in the palace, Dasaratha clung to the seat, with extreme anguish for his son.

glosses.meaning: After hearing aarta shabdam = the distressful sounds yhoram = which was horrible
in the palace mahiipatiH = king Dasaratha vyaaliiyata = clung
to the seat putra shokaabhisantaptaH = with extreme anguish for his son.

verses.devanagari:
रामः तु भ्ऱ्शम् आयस्तः निह्श्वसन्न् इव कुन्जरः |
जगाम सहितः भ्रात्रा मातुर् अन्तः पुरम् वशी
verses.iast:
rāmaḥ tu bhRśam āyastaḥ nihśvasann iva kunjaraḥ |
jagāma sahitaḥ bhrātrā mātur antaḥ puram vaśī
verses.translation: Rama, who was greatly hurt, sighed like an elephant, subdued his senses and went to his mother's palace along with Lakshmana

glosses.meaning: Rama
greatly aayastaH = hurt
sighed kuN^jaraHiva = like elephant
subdued the senses jagaama = went antaHpuram = to the palace maatuH = of mother bhraatraa sahitaH = along with brother.

verses.devanagari:
सो अपश्यत् पुरुषम् तत्र व्ऱ्द्धम् परम पूजितम् |
उपविष्टम् ग्ऱ्ह द्वारि तिष्ठतः च अपरान् बहून्
verses.iast:
so apaśyat puruṣam tatra vRddham parama pūjitam |
upaviṣṭam gRha dvāri tiṣṭhataḥ ca aparān bahūn
verses.translation: Rama saw a much worshipped old man sitting at the gateway of the house and many other standing there.

glosses.meaning: Rama apashyat = saw parama puujitam = much-worshipped vriddham purusham = old man upavishTam = sitting gR^ihadvaari = at the gateway
many aparaamshcha = others tishTataH = standing tatra = there.

verses.devanagari:
द्ऱ्^ष्ट्वै तु तदा रामं ते सर्वे सहसोत्थिताः |
जयेन जयताम् श्रेष्ठम् वर्धयन्ति स्म राघवम्
verses.iast:
dR^śhṭvai tu tadā rāmaṃ te sarve sahasotthitāḥ |
jayena jayatām śreśhṭham vardhayanti sma rāghavam
verses.translation: After seeing Rama, all of them rose quickly and greeted Rama the most triumphant man, by uttering the words "May you have increased success!"

glosses.meaning: Then

after seeing raamam = Rama te sarve = all of them utthitaaH = rose up sahasaa = quickly vardhayantisma = exhilarating their spirits jayena = by uttering "Hail! Glory!" raaghavam = to Rama jayatam shreshTam = the most triumphant man.

verses.devanagari:
प्रविश्य प्रथमाम् कक्ष्याम् द्वितीयायाम् ददर्श सः |
ब्राह्मणान् वेद सम्पन्नान् व्ऱ्द्धान् राज्ञा अभिसत्क्ऱ्तान्
verses.iast:
praviśya prathamām kakṣyām dvitīyāyām dadarśa saḥ |
brāhmaṇān veda sampannān vRddhān rāGYā abhisatkRtān
verses.translation: Rama crossed the first gate and saw old Brahmanas who were perfect in Vedas and duly honoured by the king.

glosses.meaning: That Rama pravishya = entered prathamaam kakshyaam = the first enclosure
saw dvitiiyaam = at the second gate vriddhaaan = old braahmaNaan = brahmanas
perfect in Vedas abhisatkRitaan = honoured raaGyaa = by king.

verses.devanagari:
प्रणम्य रामः तान् व्ऱ्द्धांस् त्ऱ्तीयायाम् ददर्श सः |
स्त्रियो व्ऱ्द्धाः च बालाः च द्वार रक्षण तत्पराः
verses.iast:
praṇamya rāmaḥ tān vRddhāṃs tRtīyāyām dadarśa saḥ |
striyo vRddhāḥ ca bālāḥ ca dvāra rakṣaṇa tatparāḥ
verses.translation: Rama offered salutation to those brahmanas and saw old women and girls, guarding the gate in the third enclosure.

glosses.meaning: Rama pranamya = saluted taan = those vipraan = brahmanas
saw vR^iddhaaH = old striyaH = women tathaa = and balaaH = girls dvaara rakshaNa tatparaaH = who were interested in guarding the gate tR^itiiyaayaam = the third enclosure.

verses.devanagari:
वर्धयित्वा प्रह्ऱ्ष्टाः ताः प्रविश्य च ग्ऱ्हम् स्त्रियः |
न्यवेदयन्त त्वरिता राम मातुः प्रियम् तदा
verses.iast:
vardhayitvā prahRṣṭāḥ tāḥ praviśya ca gRham striyaḥ |
nyavedayanta tvaritā rāma mātuḥ priyam tadā
verses.translation: Then those women, having been delighted, greeted Rama with good word of success, quickly entered the house and informed Kausalya about the lovely arrival of Rama .

glosses.meaning: Then taaH = those striyaH = women
having been glad
greeted Rama with word of success
quickly pravishya = entered gR^iham = house
informed raamamaatuH = Kausalya
the pleasing news.

verses.devanagari:
कौसल्या अपि तदा देवी रात्रिम् स्थित्वा समाहिता |
प्रभाते तु अकरोत् पूजाम् विष्णोह् पुत्र हित एषिणी
verses.iast:
kausalyā api tadā devī rātrim sthitvā samāhitā |
prabhāte tu akarot pūjām viṣṇoh putra hita eṣiṇī
verses.translation: At that time, Kausalya having spent the whole night with steadfastness, who performing worship to Vishnu,at dawn, for the welfare of her son.

glosses.meaning: at that time
Kausalya sthitvaa = having stayed samaahitaa = steadfast raatrim = all the night
performed pujaam = worship vishhnoH = to Vishnu prabhaate = at dawn putrahi taishhiNii = for the welfare of the son.

verses.devanagari:
सा क्षौम वसना ह्ऱ्ष्टा नित्यम् व्रत परायणा |
अग्निम् जुहोति स्म तदा मन्त्रवत् क्ऱ्त मन्गला
verses.iast:
sā kṣauma vasanā hRṣṭā nityam vrata parāyaṇā |
agnim juhoti sma tadā mantravat kRta mangalā
verses.translation: Kausalya, who was interested to practise religious vows regularly was appearing auspiciously by wearing a white silk sari and gladly performing sacrificial ceremony in a sacred fire, by reciting vedic hymns.

glosses.meaning: Kausalya vrata paraayaNaa = who was interested to pracise religious vows nityam = regularly
was wearing white silk sari kR^ita maN^galaa = made up of auspiciousness
thrilling with rapture
was doing sacrificial ceremony agnim = in fire mantravat = reciting vedic hymns.

verses.devanagari:
प्रविश्य च तदा रामः मातुर् अन्तः पुरम् शुभम् |
ददर्श मातरम् तत्र हावयन्तीम् हुत अशनम्
verses.iast:
praviśya ca tadā rāmaḥ mātur antaḥ puram śubham |
dadarśa mātaram tatra hāvayantīm huta aśanam
verses.translation: Then Rama entered the auspicious mother's apartment and saw his mother performing sacrificial ceremony in sacred fire there.

glosses.meaning: Then raAmaH = Rama provishya = entered shubham = auspicious maatuH antaHpuram = mother's apartment
saw maataram = mother haavayantiim = performing sacrificial ceremony hutaashanam = in sacred fire tatra = there.

verses.devanagari:
देवकार्यनिमित्तम् च तत्रापश्यत् समुद्यतम्|
दध्यक्षतम् घृतम् चैव मोदकान् हविषस्तदा
लाजान् माल्यानि शुक्लानि पायसम् कृसरम् तथा |
समिधः पूर्णकुम्भांश्छ ददर्श रघुनंदनः
verses.iast:
devakāryanimittam ca tatrāpaśyat samudyatam |
dadhyakśatam ghṛtam caiva modakān haviśhastadā
lājān mālyāni śuklāni pāyasam kṛsaram tathā |
samidhaḥ pūrṇakumbhāṃścha dadarśa raghunaṃdanaḥ
verses.translation: There, Rama saw the articles of worship kept ready for the purpose of the sacred ceremony like curd, unbroken rice, clarified butter, sweet meats, things fit for oblation, fried grain, garlands made of white flowers, rice boiled in milk, mixture of rice and peas with a few spices, sacrificial sticks, vessels full of water etc.

glosses.meaning: There
Rama apashyat = saw samudyatam = articles of worship kept ready devakaaryanimiHam = for the purpose of sacred ceremony
curd
clarified butter modakaan = sweet meats
and havishhaH = things fit for oblation laajaan = fried grain
white maalyaani = garlands
rice boiled in milk
mixture of rice and peas with a few spices
sacrificial sticks puurNa kumbhaashcha = vessels full of water.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् शुक्लक्षौमसम्वीताम् व्रतयोगेन कर्शिताम् |
तर्पयन्तीम् ददर्शाद्भिः देवताम् देववर्णिनीम्
verses.iast:
tām śuklakśaumasamvītām vratayogena karśitām |
tarpayantīm dadarśādbhiḥ devatām devavarṇinīm
verses.translation: Kausalya, who became lean because of observance of vows, was shining like an angel with her white silk sari and was satiating gods by presenting to them libations by water.

glosses.meaning: saw taam = Kausalya shukla kshhouma samviitaam = who was wearing white silk sari
became lean vratayogena = because of observance of vow
having appearance of an angel devataam = gods abdhiH = with water.

verses.devanagari:
सा चिरस्य आत्मजम् द्ऱ्ष्ट्वा मात्ऱ् नन्दनम् आगतम् |
अभिचक्राम सम्ह्ऱ्ष्टा किशोरम् वडवा यथा
verses.iast:
sā cirasya ātmajam dRṣṭvā mātR nandanam āgatam |
abhicakrāma samhRṣṭā kiśoram vaḍavā yathā
verses.translation: By seeing her son who came after a long time and who gave delight to mother, Kausalya was pleased and approached towards him, like a female horse approaching her young colt.

glosses.meaning: by seeing aatmajam = her son
who came chirasya = after a long time
who gave delight to his mother
Kausalya samhRishhTaa = was glad abhichakrama = approached
like a young colt
by a female horse.

verses.devanagari:
स मातरमभिक्रान्तामुपसम्गृह्य राघवः |
परिष्वक्तश्च बाहुभ्यामुपाग्रातश्च मूर्धनि
verses.iast:
sa mātaramabhikrāntāmupasamgṛhya rāghavaḥ |
pariśhvaktaśca bāhubhyāmupāgrātaśca mūrdhani
verses.translation: Rama offered salutation to the approaching mother by touching her feet. Then, she took him into her arms and smelt his head.

glosses.meaning: Rama upa samgR^ihya = offered salutation by touching the feet abhikraantam = of approaching maataram = mother
was embraced baahubhyaam = by her arms
was smelt muurdhani = in his head.

verses.devanagari:
तम् उवाच दुराधर्षम् राघवम् सुतम् आत्मनः |
कौसल्या पुत्र वात्सल्यात् इदम् प्रिय हितम् वचः
verses.iast:
tam uvāca durādharṣam rāghavam sutam ātmanaḥ |
kausalyā putra vātsalyāt idam priya hitam vacaḥ
verses.translation: Kausalya spoke these pleasing words affectionately to her son Rama, who was unassailable by enemies.

glosses.meaning: Kausalya vuvaacha = spoke idam = these priyahitham = pleasing and salutary vachaH = words putravaatsalyaat = due to affection on son aatmanaH = her sutam = son tam raaghavam = that Rama duraadharshham = who was unassailable

verses.devanagari:
व्ऱ्द्धानाम् धर्म शीलानाम् राजर्षीणाम् महात्मनाम् |
प्राप्नुहि आयुः च कीर्तिम् च धर्मम् च उपहितम् कुले
verses.iast:
vRddhānām dharma śīlānām rājarṣīṇām mahātmanām |
prāpnuhi āyuḥ ca kīrtim ca dharmam ca upahitam kule
verses.translation: "Obtain long life and glory, as obtained by the aged , the virtuous, the great souled and the royal sages .Protect the righteousness engrained in your race"

glosses.meaning: obtain aayushcha = long life
glory
and duty upahitam = engrained kule = in your race
as with the aged
the great souled
the rayol sages.

verses.devanagari:
सत्य प्रतिज्ञम् पितरम् राजानम् पश्य राघव |
अद्य एव हि त्वाम् धर्म आत्मा यौवराज्ये अभिषेक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
satya pratiGYam pitaram rājānam paśya rāghava |
adya eva hi tvām dharma ātmā yauvarājye abhiṣekṣyati
verses.translation: "Oh,Rama ! King Dasaratha ,your father is a man of true promise. Today itself, you will be installed as successor to the kingdom by your virtuous father."

glosses.meaning: Oh
see raajaanam = the king pitaram = your father
who is having true promise adyaiva = Today itself
that virtuous man abhishhekshhyati = will install tvaam = you youvaraajye = as successor to kingdom.

verses.devanagari:
दत्तमासनमालभ्य भोजनेन निमन्त्रितः |
मातरम् राघवः किंचित् प्रसार्य अन्जलिम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
dattamāsanamālabhya bhojanena nimantritaḥ |
mātaram rāghavaḥ kiṃcit prasārya anjalim abravīt
verses.translation: Kausalya asked Rama to take food , but Rama just touched the seat offered by her and after performing salutation to her, spoke thus to his mother.

glosses.meaning: Rama nimantritaH = was called bhojanena = for food
touched aasanam = the seat dattam = offered
raised kinchit = slightly aNjalim = joined palms
spoke maataram = to mother.

verses.devanagari:
स स्वभाव विनीतः च गौरवाच् च तदा आनतः |
प्रस्थितो दण्डकारण्यमाप्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
sa svabhāva vinītaḥ ca gauravāc ca tadā ānataḥ |
prasthito daṇḍakāraṇyamāpraśhṭumupacakrame
verses.translation: That Rama , being humble in nature , became still modest due to respect for his mother and was set about to ask her permission before setting forth his journey to Dandaka forest.

glosses.meaning: Then saH = that Rama
being humble in nature
and modest gouravaat = due to respect for mother
setting fourth journey daNd^akaaraNy^am = to Dandaka forest
was set about aaprasTum = to seek permission.

verses.devanagari:
देवि नूनम् न जानीषे महद् भयम् उपस्थितम् |
इदम् तव च दुह्खाय वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणस्य च
verses.iast:
devi nūnam na jānīṣe mahad bhayam upasthitam |
idam tava ca duhkhāya vaidehyā lakṣmaṇasya ca
verses.translation: "Oh,mother! You do not know that a great dismay is approaching now. It brings grief to you, to Sita and to Lakshmana"

glosses.meaning: oh
you do not know mahat = -great bhayam = dismay upasthitam = is approaching nuunam = indeed. idam = This duHkhaaya = brings grief tavaacha = to you
to Sita lakshhmaN^asyacha = and to Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
गमिष्ये दण्डकारण्यम् किमनेनासनेन मे |
विष्टरासनयोग्यो हि कालोऽयम् मामुपस्थितः
verses.iast:
gamiśhye daṇḍakāraṇyam kimanenāsanena me |
viśhṭarāsanayogyo hi kālo'yam māmupasthitaḥ
verses.translation: "I am going to Dandaka forest. Why this seat for me? Time has come for me to sit on a seat made of Kusha grass."

glosses.meaning: while going daN^dakaarNy^am = to Dandaka forest
why anena = This seat me = for me? ayam = This kaalaH = time upasthitaH = has appeared
which is fit for a seat made of kusa grass.

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने |
मधु मूल फलैः जीवन् हित्वा मुनिवद् आमिषम्
verses.iast:
caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi vatsyāmi vijane vane |
madhu mūla phalaiḥ jīvan hitvā munivad āmiṣam
verses.translation: "I shall live in a solitary forest like a sage for fourteen years, leaving off meat and living with roots, fruits and honey".

glosses.meaning: I shall live vane = in forest
bereft of people munivat = like sage chaturdasha = fourteen varshhaaNi = years hitvaa = leaving off aamishham = meat
living madhu muulaphalaiH = with honey

verses.devanagari:
भरताय महा राजो यौवराज्यम् प्रयच्चति |
माम् पुनर् दण्डक अरण्यम् विवासयति तापसम्
verses.iast:
bharatāya mahā rājo yauvarājyam prayaccati |
mām punar daṇḍaka araṇyam vivāsayati tāpasam
verses.translation: "The great king is giving to Bharata the succession to kingdom and to me, however, he is making me a sage to stay in the forest of Dandaka."

glosses.meaning: the great king prayachhati = is giving bharataaya = to Bharata youvaraajyam = the succession to kingdom. maam punaH = To me
as a sage nivaasayati = making me stay daN^dakaaraNye = in forest

verses.devanagari:
स ष्ट्चाअष्टौ च वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने |
आसेवमानो वन्यानि फलमूलैश्च चर्तयन्
verses.iast:
sa śhṭcāaśhṭau ca varśhāṇi vatsyāmi vijane vane |
āsevamāno vanyāni phalamūlaiśca cartayan
verses.translation: "I have to satisfy with the things existing in the forest and subsist with roots and fruits in a solitary forest for fourteen years."

glosses.meaning: such of myself
has to satisfy vanyaani = with things existing in the forest
live phala nuulai = with roots and fruits vatsyaami = reside in vijane vane = forest
ashhToucha = for fourteen varshhaaNi = years.

verses.devanagari:
सा निकृत्तैव सालस्य यष्टिः परशुना वने |
पपात सहसा देवी देवतेव दिवश्च्युता
verses.iast:
sā nikṛttaiva sālasya yaśhṭiḥ paraśunā vane |
papāta sahasā devī devateva divaścyutā
verses.translation: The queen Kausalya fell on the floor all at once like the branch of a tree, cut down by an axe and as an angel dropping down from heaven.

glosses.meaning: That queen papaata = fell on floor sahasaa = all at once yashTiH iva = like the branch saalasya = of the tree nikRitta = cut down parashunaa = by axe vane = in the forest
as angel chyutaa = dropping down divaH = from heaven

verses.devanagari:
ताम् अदुह्ख उचिताम् द्ऱ्ष्ट्वा पतिताम् कदलीम् इव |
रामः तु उत्थापयाम् आस मातरम् गत चेतसम्
verses.iast:
tām aduhkha ucitām dRṣṭvā patitām kadalīm iva |
rāmaḥ tu utthāpayām āsa mātaram gata cetasam
verses.translation: Seeing Kausalya who was fit to be free from sorrow, Rama lifted up her, who had fallen unconsciously on the floor like a plantain tree.

glosses.meaning: Rama dR^ishTvaa = saw taam maataram = that mother aduHkhochitaam = who was fit to be from sorrow
lifted up her gatachetanam = who lost consciousness
who fell on the floor kadaLiimiva = like a plantain tree.

verses.devanagari:
उपाव्ऱ्त्य उत्थिताम् दीनाम् वडवाम् इव वाहिताम् |
पांशु गुण्ठित सर्व अग्नीम् विममर्श च पाणिना
verses.iast:
upāvRtya utthitām dīnām vaḍavām iva vāhitām |
pāṃśu guṇṭhita sarva agnīm vimamarśa ca pāṇinā
verses.translation: Rama touched with his hand that miserable Kausalya,whose limbs were covered with fragrant powder and who rose like a loaded horse from the floor on which it rolled from side to side.

glosses.meaning: Rama touched paaNinaa = with hand diinaam = miserable Kausalya
whose limbs were covered with fragrant powder badamaamiva = like a female horse
made to be carried of load
rose upaavR^ittya = after rolling from side to side.

verses.devanagari:
सा राघवम् उपासीनम् असुख आर्ता सुख उचिता |
उवाच पुरुष व्याघ्रम् उपश्ऱ्ण्वति लक्ष्मणे
verses.iast:
sā rāghavam upāsīnam asukha ārtā sukha ucitā |
uvāca puruṣa vyāghram upaśRṇvati lakṣmaṇe
verses.translation: Kausalya, who was fit for happiness but was afflicted with grief, spoke thus to Rama the best of men who was sitting nearby, while Lakshmana was hearing.

glosses.meaning: That kausalya = sukhochita = who was fit for happiness asukhaartaa = but afflicted with sorrow
spoke raaghavam = to Rama purushhavyaaghram = the best of men upaasiinam = who was sitting nearby
while Lakshmana upashR^iNvati = was hearing.

verses.devanagari:
यदि पुत्र न जायेथा मम शोकाय राघव |
न स्म दुह्खम् अतः भूयः पश्येयम् अहम् अप्रजा
verses.iast:
yadi putra na jāyethā mama śokāya rāghava |
na sma duhkham ataḥ bhūyaḥ paśyeyam aham aprajā
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! I would not have felt this much grief if I were childless .You are born only to produce sorrow to me."

glosses.meaning: oh

Rama! jayethaaH yadi = If you were not born shokaaya = to cause grief mama = to me aham = I nasma pashyeyam = would not have seen bhuuyaH = greater duHkham = grief ataH = than this aprajaaH = without progeny.

verses.devanagari:
एकएव हि वन्ध्यायाः शोको भवति मानवः |
अप्रजा अस्मि इति सम्तापो न हि अन्यः पुत्र विद्यते
verses.iast:
ekaeva hi vandhyāyāḥ śoko bhavati mānavaḥ |
aprajā asmi iti samtāpo na hi anyaḥ putra vidyate
verses.translation: "Oh, son! There is no other grief to a barren woman except the only worry that "I have no sons".

glosses.meaning: Oh

There is no anyaH = other santaapaH = grief vandhyaayaaH = to a barren women bhavati hi = There is indeed ekaH = one shokaH eva = only grief maanasaH = relating to mind iti = that asmi aprajaaH "I have no children"

verses.devanagari:
न द्ऱ्ष्ट पूर्वम् कल्याणम् सुखम् वा पति पौरुषे |
अपि पुत्रे विपश्येयम् इति राम आस्थितम् मया
verses.iast:
na dRṣṭa pūrvam kalyāṇam sukham vā pati pauruṣe |
api putre vipaśyeyam iti rāma āsthitam mayā
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! I have not seen any happiness or prosperity earlier, while my husband is in power. I believed that I could see them at last when my son comes to power."

glosses.meaning: oh

earlier was not seen sukham vaa = happiness or kalyaaNam = prospering pate pourushhe = during my husband's manliness. asthitam = It was believed mayaa = by me iti = that api pashyeyam = can I see putre_api = at least in my son

verses.devanagari:
सा बहूनि अमनोज्ञानि वाक्यानि ह्ऱ्दयच्चिदाम् |
अहम् श्रोष्ये सपत्नीनाम् अवराणाम् वरा सती
verses.iast:
sā bahūni amanoGYāni vākyāni hRdayaccidām |
aham śroṣye sapatnīnām avarāṇām varā satī
verses.translation: "I have to hear so many disagreeable words from my fellow-wives who are inferior to me and who pierce my heart with their words though I am a better and virtuous wife among them."

glosses.meaning: such a person as myself
who is a better and virtuous wife
so many amaroG^Yaani = disagreeable vaakyaani = words sapatniinaam = of fellow wives
who are inferior to me
who pierce the heart.

verses.devanagari:
अतः दुह्खतरम् किम् नु प्रमदानाम् भविष्यति |
त्वयि सम्निहिते अपि एवम् अहम् आसम् निराक्ऱ्ता
verses.iast:
ataḥ duhkhataram kim nu pramadānām bhaviṣyati |
tvayi samnihite api evam aham āsam nirākRtā
verses.translation: "Which one will be more sorrowful to women than this unending and consuming grief that occurred to me now?"

glosses.meaning: which one bhavishhyati = will be duHkhataram = more sorrowful pramadaanaam = to women ataH = than yaadR^ishaH = which -anantakaH = unending vilaapashcha = and dissolving shokaH = grief mama = to me

verses.devanagari:
त्वयि सन्निहितेऽप्येवमहमासं निराकृता |
किम् पुनः प्रोषिते तात ध्रुवम् मरणम् एव मे
verses.iast:
tvayi sannihite'pyevamahamāsaṃ nirākṛtā |
kim punaḥ proṣite tāta dhruvam maraṇam eva me
verses.translation: "Even when you are near by, I am being rejected. What to tell after you leave for exile? Death indeed is certain to me."

glosses.meaning: Oh

glosses.itrans: father(a term of affection addressed to a junior) tvayi sannihite api
glosses.iast: father(a term of affection addressed to a junior) tvayi sannihite api
glosses.devanagari: fअथेर्(अ तेर्ं ओf अffएच्तिओन् अद्द्रेस्सेद् तो अ जुनिओर्) त्वयि सन्निहिते अपि
glosses.meaning: Even when you are nearby
I niraakR^itaa aasam = was rejected evam = thus kim punaH = what to tell proshhite = when you go to exile. maraNam = death dhR^ivam is certain me = to me

verses.devanagari:
अत्यन्तनिगृहीतास्मि भर्तुर्नित्य्मतन्त्रिता |
परिवारेण कैकेय्या समा वाप्यथवाऽवरा
verses.iast:
atyantanigṛhītāsmi bharturnitymatantritā |
parivāreṇa kaikeyyā samā vāpyathavā'varā
verses.translation: "My husband always held me down, without giving me any independence and treat me equal to or even lower than the servants of Kaikeyi"

glosses.meaning: Iam
held down heaving bhartuH = by husband
without independence samaava = equal to athavaa = or avaraa = lower than parivaareNa = servants kaikeyyaaH = of Kaikeyi

verses.devanagari:
यो हि माम् सेवते कश्चित् अथ वा अपि अनुवर्तते |
कैकेय्याः पुत्रम् अन्वीक्ष्य स जनो न अभिभाषते
verses.iast:
yo hi mām sevate kaścit atha vā api anuvartate |
kaikeyyāḥ putram anvīkṣya sa jano na abhibhāṣate
verses.translation: Those who serve me now and those who follow me, will not speak to me, after seeing Bharata".

glosses.meaning: kashchit = Anyone whatsoever sevate = serves maam = me athava = or anuvartate = follows saHjanaH = that person na abhibhaashhate hi = will not indeed speak anviikshhya = after seeing kaikeyyaaH = Kaikeyi's putram = son

verses.devanagari:
नित्यक्रोधतया तस्याः कथं नु खरवादि तत् |
कैकेय्या वदनम् द्रष्टुम् पुत्र शक्ष्यामि दुर्गता
verses.iast:
nityakrodhatayā tasyāḥ kathaṃ nu kharavādi tat |
kaikeyyā vadanam draśhṭum putra śakśyāmi durgatā
verses.translation: Oh, son! How can I, the miserable one, see the face of Kaikeyi who talks hurtingly because of her continuous anger."

glosses.meaning: oh
Myself
how shakshhyaami = can I be able drashhTum = to see adanam = face tasyaaH kaikeyyaaH = of that Kaikeyi khara vaadi = who talks hurtingly nitya krodhatayaa

verses.devanagari:
दश सप्त च वर्षाणि तव जातस्य राघव |
असितानि प्रकान्क्षन्त्या मया दुह्ख परिक्षयम्
verses.iast:
daśa sapta ca varṣāṇi tava jātasya rāghava |
asitāni prakānkṣantyā mayā duhkha parikṣayam
verses.translation: "Oh,Rama! I have been waiting for seventeen years after your second birth of thread ceremony, with the hope that my troubles will disappear at one time or the other."

glosses.meaning: Oh

sat down mayaa = by me dasha saptacha = for seventeen varshhaa Ni = years tava jaatasya = after your second birth of your thread ceremony praakaaNkshhantyaa = with hope of duHkha parikshhantyaam = disappearance of troubles

verses.devanagari:
तदक्षयम् महाद्दुःखम् नोत्सहे सहितुम् चिरम् |
विप्रकारम् सपत्नीनामेवम् जीर्णापि राघव
verses.iast:
tadakśayam mahādduḥkham notsahe sahitum ciram |
viprakāram sapatnīnāmevam jīrṇāpi rāghava
verses.translation: Oh, Rama! In this old age, I cannot bear insult from co-wives and this unending sorrow for a long time.

glosses.meaning: oh
for that reason
in the way jiir Naapi = even if old aged
I do not wish sahitum = to bear viprakaaram = insult sapatniinaam = of co-wives
un-ending mahat = great du Hkham = sorrow chiram = for long time

verses.devanagari:
अपश्यन्ती तव मुखम् परिपूर्णशशिप्रभम् |
कृपणा वर्तयिष्यामि कथम् कृपणजीविकाम्
verses.iast:
apaśyantī tava mukham paripūrṇaśaśiprabham |
kṛpaṇā vartayiśhyāmi katham kṛpaṇajīvikām
verses.translation: "How can I the pitiable one, spend this miserable life without seeing your face radiating like full moon."

glosses.meaning: How kR^ipaNaa = the pitiable me
can roll on kR^ipaNa jiivikaam = this miserable life apashhyantii = without seeing tava = your mukham = face
radiating like full moon

verses.devanagari:
उपवासैः च योगैः च बहुभिः च परिश्रमैः |
दुह्खम् सम्वर्धितः मोघम् त्वम् हि दुर्गतया मया
verses.iast:
upavāsaiḥ ca yogaiḥ ca bahubhiḥ ca pariśramaiḥ |
duhkham samvardhitaḥ mogham tvam hi durgatayā mayā
verses.translation: "You were nourished in vain by me ,the important one by fasts, by meditations, by various difficult and painful vows ."

glosses.meaning: you samvardhitaH = were nourished mogham = in vain mayaa = by me durgatayaa = the unfortunate one
and painful voes.

verses.devanagari:
स्थिरम् तु हृदयम् मन्ये मम इदम् यन् न दीर्यते |
प्रावृषि इव महा नद्याः स्पृष्टम् कूलम् नव अम्भसा
verses.iast:
sthiram tu hṛdayam manye mama idam yan na dīryate |
prāvṛṣi iva mahā nadyāḥ spṛṣṭam kūlam nava ambhasā
verses.translation: "My heart is not breached, as bank of a great river, struck by new water in monsoon, by hearing this news.That is why, I feel it is strong."

glosses.meaning: This

my hR^idayam = heart yat = for which reason na diiryate = is not breached kuulam iva = like bank mahaanadyaa = of great river spR^ishhTam = struck navaam bhasaa = by new water praavR^ishhi = in rainy season
I think it sthhiram = as strong.

verses.devanagari:
मम एव नूनम् मरणम् न विद्यते |
न च अवकाशो अस्ति यम क्षये मम |
यद् अन्तको अद्य एव न माम् जिहीर्षति |
प्रसह्य सिम्हो रुदतीम् म्ऱ्गीम् इव
verses.iast:
mama eva nūnam maraṇam na vidyate |
na ca avakāśo asti yama kṣaye mama |
yad antako adya eva na mām jihīrṣati |
prasahya simho rudatīm mRgīm iva
verses.translation: "There is no death to me, indeed .I have no place in the abode of god yama who presides over the spirits of the dead .That is why, Yama is not forcingly carrying me off like a lion carrying off a wailing antelope."

glosses.meaning: There is no maraNam = death naasti = There is no nuunam = indeed. avakaashaH = place
to me yamakshhaye = in the abode of yama. yat = for which reason
yama
is not wishing to carry off maam = me adyaiva = now itself prasahya = forcibly.

verses.devanagari:
स्थिरम् हि नूनम् हृदयम् मम आयसम् |
न भिद्यते यद् भुवि न अवदीर्यते |
अनेन दुःखेन च देहम् अर्पितम् |
ध्रुवम् हि अकाले मरणम् न विद्यते
verses.iast:
sthiram hi nūnam hṛdayam mama āyasam |
na bhidyate yad bhuvi na avadīryate |
anena duḥkhena ca deham arpitam |
dhruvam hi akāle maraṇam na vidyate
verses.translation: "This grief is inserted into my body. Even then, my heart is stable. It has not broken into pieces and fallen on the floor .It is indeed made of iron. There is no untimely death, it is certain"

glosses.meaning: By the grief

body arpitam = is pierced. nuunam = Indeed mama = my hR^idayam = heart sthhiram = which is hard aayasam = is made of iron. yat = for which reason na bhidyate = it is not broken naavadiiryate = it has not fallen into pieces
on the floor na vidyate = There is no akaale = untimely = maraNam = death dhR^ivam = It is certain.

verses.devanagari:
इदम् तु दुःखम् यद् अनर्थकानि मे|
व्रतानि दानानि च सम्यमाः च हि |
तपः च तप्तम् यद् अपत्य कारणात् |
सुनिष्फलम् बीजम् इव उप्तम् ऊषरे
verses.iast:
idam tu duḥkham yad anarthakāni me |
vratāni dānāni ca samyamāḥ ca hi |
tapaḥ ca taptam yad apatya kāraṇāt |
suniṣphalam bījam iva uptam ūṣare
verses.translation: "I feel bad since all my religious vows, charities, restraints have all gone waste.The austerity I performed for the sake of of -spring has gone in vain, as a seed sown in a saline soil."

glosses.meaning: This is duHkham = sad anarthakaaniiti = to speak about waste of me = my vrataani = religious voes daanaamicha = charities samyamaashcha = and restraints. yat = which tapaH = austerity taptam = is performed apatya kaaraNaat = for the sake of offspring
is completely in vain biijam iva = as seed uptam = sown uushhare = in saline soil.

verses.devanagari:
यदि हि अकाले मरणम् स्वया इच्चया |
लभेत कश्चित् गुरु दुःख कर्शितः |
गता अहम् अद्य एव परेत संसदम् |
विना त्वया धेनुर् इव आत्मजेन वै
verses.iast:
yadi hi akāle maraṇam svayā iccayā |
labheta kaścit guru duḥkha karśitaḥ |
gatā aham adya eva pareta saṃsadam |
vinā tvayā dhenur iva ātmajena vai
verses.translation: "If a man in great distress can get premature death out of his own will, I being separated from you ,would have attain the glory of the dead now itself like cow without the calf."

glosses.meaning: If a person guruduHkhakarshitaH = in great distress labheta yadi = can get akaale = premature maraNam = death svayaa = ichchhayaa = out of his own will
I gataa = would have got pareta sampadam = glory of the dead adyaiva = now itself tvayaa vinaa = without you dhenuriva = like cow aatmajenavina = without calf

verses.devanagari:
अथापि किम् जीवित मद्य मे वृथा |
त्वया विना च्न्द्रनिभाननप्रभ |
अनुव्रजिष्यामि वनम् त्वयैव गौः |
सुदुर्बला वत्समिवानुकाङ्क्षया
verses.iast:
athāpi kim jīvita madya me vṛthā |
tvayā vinā cndranibhānanaprabha |
anuvrajiśhyāmi vanam tvayaiva gauḥ |
sudurbalā vatsamivānukāṇ^kśayā
verses.translation: "Moreover, what is the use of life? Oh, Rama! With your brilliant face shining like moon! My life is useless without you. I shall accompany you to the forest like a weak cow going behind it's calf"

glosses.meaning: Moreover
oh

glosses.itrans: Rama! With your brilliant face shining like moon! kim
glosses.iast: Rama! With your brilliant face śining like moon! kim
glosses.devanagari: Rअम! Wइथ् योउर् ब्रिल्लिअन्त् fअचे शिनिन्ग् लिके मोओन्! किं
glosses.meaning: what me = my jiivitam = life tvayaavinaa = without you! vR^ithaa = waste indeed. adya = Now anuvrajishhyaami = Ican accompany tvayaiva = you only vanam = to the forest
like with calf sudurbalaa = a completely weak cow gouH = cow anukaaNkshhayaa = with compassion

verses.devanagari:
भृशम् असुखम् अमर्षिता तदा |
बहु विललाप समीक्ष्य राघवम् |
व्यसनम् उपनिशाम्य सा महत् |
सुतम् इव बद्धम् अवेक्ष्य किम्नरी
verses.iast:
bhṛśam asukham amarṣitā tadā |
bahu vilalāpa samīkṣya rāghavam |
vyasanam upaniśāmya sā mahat |
sutam iva baddham avekṣya kimnarī
verses.translation: Then, that Kausalya looked at Rama to whom a great calamity has occurred, saw her son bound by grief and lamented very much in various ways like a kinnara woman.

glosses.meaning: Then

beholden with mahat = great vyasanam = calamity
